versions.changelog:
- Initial release of dev-var-name: a programmer variable name generator.
- Converts Chinese or English keywords into 7 popular naming styles (camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, SCREAMING_SNAKE, kebab-case, dot.case, path/case).
- Produces both full and abbreviation versions for each naming style.
- Includes a comprehensive abbreviation rule table and fallback logic for words not in the table.
- Supports Chinese input with built-in pinyin and first-letter rules.
